title: odontarrhena obtusifolia
intro: Odontarrhena obtusifolia, commonly known as toothache plant, is a type of flowering plant native to South Africa. This plant is known for its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been traditionally used to treat toothaches, headaches, and other minor pain. The health benefits of Odontarrhena obtusifolia include pain relief and inflammation reduction, which is attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant are sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
